rounds.text: Yash Chemex is currently undergoing a significant operational turnaround, evidenced by a 31% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E19] and accelerating earnings [E64]. Management is demonstrating strong conviction in this trajectory, as evidenced by the increase in promoter holdings to 64.61% [E40]. The company is successfully optimizing its balance sheet, with working capital requirements dropping from 140 days to 107 days [E56] and a comfortable current ratio of 2.72x [E37]. Furthermore, the business is benefiting from a sector-wide tailwind [E70, E72], and recent results show the company is beginning to outperform expectations with profit growth exceeding one-year price growth by 37% [E54]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with a 0.00% dividend yield [E4], a lack of operating cash flow in the most recent period [E33], and a low return on equity [E9, E13, E66]. Despite these historical metrics, the current momentum in profit growth [E61, E62, E63] suggests that the market may be relying on stale sentiment rather than the improving underlying performance [E71].
